overview.text: Soil_1_32 is a nonribosomal peptide and azole-containing-RiPP cluster detected by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO, spanning 103 kb on contig_1 with 42 genes.

genes.text: antiSMASH marks 12 genes as biosynthetic (7 core and 5 additional), with 4 regulatory and 6 transport genes.
CJLEIP_03619 is a core gene with 3 modules predicting leucine, phenylalanine and no substrate, and 2 modules carrying an epimerization domain.
CJLEIP_03620 is a core gene with 6 modules predicting alanine for 2, valine for 2, leucine for 1 and isoleucine for 1, and 3 modules carrying an epimerization domain.
CJLEIP_03621 is a core gene with 4 modules predicting threonine, valine, leucine and tryptophan, and 1 module carrying an epimerization domain.

Together the six core genes CJLEIP_03619, CJLEIP_03620, CJLEIP_03621, CJLEIP_03622, CJLEIP_03623 and CJLEIP_03624 hold 18 modules; antiSMASH predicts a substrate for 16 modules (leucine for 3, phenylalanine for 1, alanine for 3, valine for 3, isoleucine for 3, threonine for 1, tryptophan for 1 and lysine for 1) and none for 1 module; 1 module has no adenylation or acyltransferase domain; 8 modules carry an epimerization domain.

Additional biosynthetic genes include CJLEIP_03631 (MbtH family protein), CJLEIP_03604 (GTP cyclohydrolase I FolE), CJLEIP_03625 (Serine hydrolase), CJLEIP_03632 (Alpha/beta hydrolase) and CJLEIP_03633 (Aldehyde dehydrogenase domain-containing protein).

similar.text: The closest known cluster is BGC0001792 (surugamide A and surugamide D) from Streptomyces albidoflavus, a close match with 23 genes having counterparts at 98–100 % identity.

CJLEIP_03619 matches XNR_3446 at 99 % identity, CJLEIP_03620 matches XNR_3447 at 100 % identity, CJLEIP_03621 matches XNR_3448 at 100 % identity, CJLEIP_03622 matches XNR_3449 at 100 % identity, CJLEIP_03623 matches XNR_3449 at 99 % identity and CJLEIP_03624 matches XNR_3449 at 99 % identity.
MIBiG lists the compound class of BGC0001792 as NRPS and records antifungal activity for surugamide A and surugamide D, with questionable annotation quality.

hypothesis.text: The cluster may produce a nonribosomal peptide with antifungal activity, given the close match to a known antifungal NRPS cluster and the presence of core NRPS genes predicting diverse amino acid substrates.

facts.sentence: Soil_1_32 is a nonribosomal peptide and azole-containing-RiPP cluster, found by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO (all three detection tools).
It spans 103 kb on contig_1 (4,060,268–4,163,383) and contains 42 genes.
antiSMASH marks 12 genes as biosynthetic (7 core and 5 additional), 4 as regulatory and 6 as transport.
6 core genes are named in the locus, each by at least one of antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO.

CJLEIP_03619, annotated by Bakta as D-alanine--poly(phosphoribitol) ligase subunit DltA, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH finds 3 modules in it, and predicts leucine, phenylalanine and no substrate for its adenylation domains; 2 of its modules carry an epimerization domain.

CJLEIP_03620, annotated by Bakta as solanimycin non-ribosomal peptide synthetase SolG, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH finds 6 modules in it, and predicts alanine for 2, valine for 2, leucine for 1 and isoleucine for 1 for its adenylation domains; 3 of its modules carry an epimerization domain.

CJLEIP_03621, annotated by Bakta as D-alanine--poly(phosphoribitol) ligase subunit DltA, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH finds 4 modules in it, and predicts threonine, valine, leucine and tryptophan for its adenylation domains; 1 of its modules carries an epimerization domain.

CJLEIP_03622, annotated by Bakta as Amino acid adenylation domain-containing protein, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH finds 2 modules in it, and predicts lysine for its adenylation domain; 1 of its modules carries an epimerization domain.

CJLEIP_03623, annotated by Bakta as condensation domain-containing protein, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH finds 1 module in it, and predicts isoleucine for its adenylation domain.

CJLEIP_03624, annotated by Bakta as Amino acid adenylation domain-containing protein, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH finds 2 modules in it, and predicts alanine and isoleucine for its adenylation domains; 1 of its modules carries an epimerization domain.

Together CJLEIP_03619, CJLEIP_03620, CJLEIP_03621, CJLEIP_03622, CJLEIP_03623 and CJLEIP_03624 hold 18 modules; antiSMASH predicts a substrate for 16 modules (leucine for 3, phenylalanine for 1, alanine for 3, valine for 3, isoleucine for 3, threonine for 1, tryptophan for 1 and lysine for 1) and none for 1 module; 1 module has no adenylation or acyltransferase domain; 8 modules carry an epimerization domain.
CJLEIP_03631 encodes MbtH family protein and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_03604 encodes GTP cyclohydrolase I FolE and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_03625 encodes Serine hydrolase and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_03632 encodes Alpha/beta hydrolase and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_03633 encodes Aldehyde dehydrogenase domain-containing protein and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
